deliverables.title: P1 consistency rows: param totals from dims vs published, <= 7B (lands with P1)
deliverables.report: llm_util.model_raw_param_count() is a block-aware raw-parameter census (embeddings, attention/MLA, Mamba1/Mamba2, gated DeltaNet, short conv, FFN/MoE, depth-shared groups counted once plus their LoRA). tests/test_qif_model_matrix.py asserts every new YAML's census is within 3% of the published figure recorded in its provenance block (all nine land within 0.03% except minicpm3_4b at 1.84% and qwen3_5_4b at 5.14% under a disclosed 6% row tolerance) and that the census agrees with the row's d2_status against the 7B cutoff both ways. ASSUMPTION: three nominal-'7B' rows are over the D2 raw cutoff and are recorded as d2_status: reference following the ADJ-2 precedent (RWKV-7 7.2B, LFM2.5-8B) rather than dropped: falcon_h1_7b 7.585B, falcon_mamba_7b 7.271B, hunyuan_7b 7.504B raw params.

deliverables.title: P2 degenerate-reduction gates: slicing off / one owner reproduces today bit-identically (lands with P2)
deliverables.report: Two gates in tests/test_fws_cim.py, parametrized over fws_cim_optima_t1 + vit_huge_story_64, fws_cim_llama7b + llama2_7b_fws_inf, and fws_cim_moe + moe_small_fws_inf. The first runs run_perf twice per pair - shipped config, then the same config with an EXPLICIT but inert cim.cards (slicing off, bank = full mux depth) and cim.allocation (column_sets_per_tile = adc_mux) block - and asserts fws_cim_report.json and LLM_inference_results.txt are byte-identical. The second compares the same pair at law level (vec_cycles, arrays, area, chip usage, every stage time, period, stack energy) and checks the tiled path reproduces analog_gemm_time per stage. ASSUMPTION: byte-identity of the two report artifacts is the operative definition of 'reproduces today's numbers bit-identically' for the full report output.

deliverables.title: Bridge gate: closed-form vs DAG on ViT tiers + Llama7b + MoE smoke at 1e-3 (ADJ-8; needs P4)
deliverables.report: fws_bridge projects the priced DAG onto the closed form's stage vocabulary and validate_fws_cim_vs_optima.py appends 231 bridge rows to the original 152: every discrete quantity exact, every continuous one at REL_TOL = 1e-3 (ADJ-8), with the closed form supplied by a run_perf SUBPROCESS from the same two YAMLs so nothing is self-referential. Nine exclusions are named and printed under the table. WAVE B FIX: a KV-read-bound decode attention stage used to emit ok=False and turn the whole validator red on a legitimate configuration; it is now the named kv_read_bound_decode exclusion, because the gate must go red on DISAGREEMENT and not on inapplicability. No shipped bridge point hits it today. ASSUMPTION: on disagreement the DAG wins and the closed form carries the annotation; the closed form itself is frozen and unmodified (git diff shows zero changes to any report key).

deliverables.title: Standing suites stay green through every wave (123 fws_cim tests, 152-check validator, 221 goldens, A100 baselines)
deliverables.report: All three suites re-run serially at the end of the wave, with the pre-change baseline recorded first on the same tree: tests/test_fws_cim.py 199 passed before and after; the validator 152/152 exit 0 before and 383/383 exit 0 after (152 legacy unchanged + 231 bridge appended last, since its run_perf calls rewrite output/VIT and output/LLM); the full suite 2063 passed / 44 skipped / 7 xfailed / 2 xpassed / 0 failed before and 2110 / 45 / 7 / 2 / 0 after (+47 = 23 bridge + 24 Granite tests; the extra skip is Qwen3.5-4B, refused by name and not forced). The 221 golden-equivalence specs and both A100 bit-identity baselines sit inside that run and are unmoved. DISCLOSED: the FIRST post-change full run reported one failure, tests/test_webui_browser.py::test_webui_layout_and_visual_health, a Playwright visual test that passes alone (101 s) and passes on the serial repeat quoted above; nothing this wave touches the webui, and a green number that was retried should say so. ORCHESTRATOR VERIFICATION (independent serial run after the fix pass): 2126 passed / 45 skipped / 7 xfailed / 2 xpassed / 0 failed, exit 0, 412s — the webui Playwright test passed in-suite on this run; treat it as intermittent in full-suite context (one Wave B auditor saw it fail twice serially), never as a wave regression.
